name: @runlumi/bi

scripts.build:packages: npm run build --workspace @runlumi/core && npm run build --workspace @runlumi/cloudflare && npm run build --workspace @runlumi/ui
scripts.check: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck && npm test && node --experimental-strip-types scripts/check-repo.mjs && npm run check:boundaries && npm run check:licensing
scripts.build:web: npm --prefix apps/web run build && node scripts/web-notices.mjs
scripts.check:core: npm run build:packages && tsc --noEmit && npm test

description: Cloudflare-first tenant-isolated BI with a central control plane and Git configuration releases.
